title: El Morro RV Park and Cabins

services.name: Winter Cabin Rental
services.desc: The El Morro area often has mild winters but 3" - 5" snows are typical, with the majority melting off by the end of the day. We are located just off HWY 53, county snow plows can usually maintain our access to both nearby towns, Grants and Gallup, each on I-40. All of this makes a winter rental of one of our Cabins a lovely winter getaway. Even during the winter there are many things to do locally. Have a delicious breakfast or lunch at the Cafe. The Old School Gallery across the street hosts numerous events throughout the year, from concerts and open mics, to festivals, dinners, and art showings. Winter is a great time to take in the quiet and appreciate this pristine and sacred land. You
